purpose: Verified contract for safely expanding an approved property answer into a linked citizen follow-up.
context_rule: Preserve verified property, jurisdiction, registration and relevant temporal context unless the citizen changes it.
intent_rule: Classify the new question independently even when prior context is reusable.
time_rule: A changed or newly specified date creates a new temporal scope.
property_rule: A new property reference requires identity verification; prior property identity is not silently transferred.
evidence_rule: New questions receive their own minimum evidence profile; prior evidence is reused only when eligible.
snapshot_rule: The parent answer snapshot remains immutable; follow-up work is linked as a new question/sub-investigation.
scope_rule: Only the dimension actually requested by the citizen is added.
privacy_rule: Related private context is not exposed merely because the follow-up refers to the same property.
verification_boundary: Question expansion routes and scopes follow-up work; it does not establish new facts or legal conclusions.
